title: The Final Echo
author: Freya Whitlock
blurb: Tamsin Sandoval, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
